invariants.rationale: The metaClient parameter is expected to be provided and not null in most Hadoop/Hudi-related operations.
The columnsToIndex parameter should not be null to avoid NullPointerException if accessed.
The method signature ensures columnsToIndex must be a List.
The method signature ensures metaClient must be a HoodieTableMetaClient.
By contract, Java List size is always non-negative.
